g.title: W1
g.text: INFERRED landing. Winding pairs assumed board 1+3 (F2+F4) and 6+8 (F1+F3),
from Mercury bits 0-3 following A, B, A', B'. Which winding goes where, and which end, is not documented.

g.title: B1
g.text: Board pins 2, 4, 5, 7 joined on the board (UMC0005 s2.5.1).

g.title: W2
g.text: Board to Fischer per UMC0005 s2.5.1. Internal wiring form (wires or tracks) not documented.

g.title: X1
g.text: receptacle, gender not given by OI
102 A056 inferred. Face 1 centre, 2 at key, 3-7 round ring.

g.title: S1
g.text: NC dry contact, closed end of travel

g.title: W3
g.text: Switch to Fischer 6/7 directly (UMC0005 s2.5.1 note). Which switch lead goes to 6 or 7 does not matter.
